content_zh:
答案很简单，顺着这条线揪出线另一端的人。
邢烨有无数种方法抵达皇城，为什么最终偏偏选择了操纵者准备的路？正是为了找到幕后之人。
机会永远留给有准备的人，想要在对方的陷阱中反败为胜，就要做好万全的准备。一路上邢烨做出了上百种设想，先从系统角度出发，游戏本身想要通过他们这些玩家身上得到什么，只要想清楚这一点才能分析出游戏中对他隐藏的规则。
其次是从操纵者的角度出发，根据年长女仆的表现，三名操纵者是有联系方法的，也就是说，最初设定结局时他们一定是商议过的。占尽优势的情况下，如果他是操纵者，一定会根据故事的走向设定两个完全相反的结局。
即克莱尔被女王杀死以及克莱尔战胜女王，操纵者只要一人选择一条结局，那么最后无论邢烨怎么做迎接他的只有失败。这两个结局与年长女仆的设定有异曲同工之妙，看来卢卡伯爵中那一场是试水，皇宫中等待着他的才是真正的终盘。
最后则是邢烨自身的角度，有些时候，从自身出发，回想自扫描二维码开始至今发生的所有事情，或许会在细节中发现意料之外的信息。
除了思考这些外，邢烨还从骑士团中了解到这个世界的规则，平民与贵族的划分，皇族、贵族、教会三者之间的平衡，他是做足准备，才有信心挑拨骑士队长的。
见骑士队长果然出离愤怒，邢烨在心中微微松口气。
看来对方阵营的人似乎还是将这个世界当做普通的游戏世界，未意识到这是一个构建完整的世界，每一个NPC都是有灵魂的人，擅自闯入的是他们玩家。
在搜身这件事上，最正确的做法应该是将贵族和平民分开，先是恭恭敬敬地将人请到住处，在由身份高的人出面，与勋爵自身说明利害关系，待勋爵们同意后，才可以派与骑士们有同样地位的人来搜身。
在这样一个复杂的世界，如果不考虑到方方面面，就算有权力也不可能让其他人按自己的心思行动。
“体面”、“形式主义”一类的词语看似毫无意义，可就是有些贵族，宁可卖房卖地债台高筑，也要维持与自己爵位相匹配的体面。古代如此，现在亦然，无论哪个时代，都不要低估人心。
加西亚公爵的货队骚乱起来，不尊重人的话语迅速传遍队伍每一个角落。
等着进城的平民并不在意这些事，可此时女王生日将近，门前大都是外地来送礼的贵族货队，原本排队等待就让他们十分不满，这样的话传开后，他们也开始抗拒。
一切的始作俑者邢烨在煽动骑士队长后，悄悄退回到队伍中，消息如潮水般散开，又有谁知道源头在哪里呢？
莫尔斯凑到邢烨身边，不死心地说：“劳伦斯，加西亚公爵已经先一步抵达皇城，我们经过检查后会将货物运送到他的府邸，到时候我向公爵推荐你这名优秀的骑士如何？”
邢烨没有反对：“好。”
莫尔斯被拒绝一路，此时见他点头开心得差点跳起来。
邢烨则是摸了摸怀中的镜子，舆论已经煽动起来，接下来确实要去见一见加西亚公爵了，不过不是做骑士，而是要试验一下系统给予他的金手指。
“怎么回事？”一个看起来像队长的人走过来，状似不经意地站在加西亚公爵货队旁，“为什么骚动这么大？”

“阁下就是皇族卫队的侍卫长？”骑士队长不卑不亢地行了一个平礼，“我们是加西亚公爵的骑士团，车上的货物是公爵殿下送给女王陛下的生日贺礼，您是打算让我们这样的队伍，堵在城门口，在一干平民、奴隶、偏远小贵族的面前，被区区城门守卫搜身吗？请问您这样的举动，有经过加西亚公爵的同意吗？”
听到他的话和加西亚公爵的身份，周围的贵族骑士团也纷纷聚集起来，众人齐声附和，要求皇族给予贵族们应有的体面。
闹哄哄的场面让侍卫有些慌，他立刻拔出剑大声喝道道：“这是女王的命令，皇族卫队仅忠于女王陛下，我们会执行女王的每一个命令。陛下是为了整个国家的安全考虑，你们是要反叛吗？”
隐藏在人群内暗中观察的邢烨扶额，很明显，侍卫长就是第二名操纵者，他选择的结局是女王抓住私藏镜子的克莱尔并处死。

content_en:
The answer is simple, follow the line and find the person on the other end of the line.
Xing Ye had countless ways to reach the imperial city, so why did he finally choose the path prepared by the manipulator? Just to find the person behind the scenes.
Opportunities are always reserved for those who are prepared. If you want to turn defeat into victory in the opponent's trap, you must be fully prepared. Along the way, Xing Ye made hundreds of assumptions. Starting from a system perspective, what does the game itself want to gain from players like them? Only by thinking clearly about this can he analyze the rules hidden in the game for him.
Secondly, from the perspective of the manipulator, based on the performance of the older maid, the three manipulators have a way of contacting each other. In other words, they must have discussed it when the ending was originally set. If he has the upper hand, if he is the manipulator, he will definitely set two completely opposite endings depending on the direction of the story.
That is, Claire is killed by the queen and Claire defeats the queen. As long as the manipulator chooses one ending, no matter what Xing Ye does, he will only fail. These two endings are similar to the setting of the elderly maid. It seems that the scene with Count Luca is a test of the waters, and what awaits him in the palace is the real ending.
Finally, it is Xing Ye’s own perspective. Sometimes, starting from himself and recalling everything that has happened since scanning the QR code, you may find unexpected information in the details.
In addition to thinking about these things, Xing Ye also learned about the rules of this world from the knights, the division between civilians and nobles, and the balance between the royal family, nobles, and the church. Only after he was fully prepared did he have the confidence to provoke the knight captain.
Seeing that the knight captain was really angry, Xing Ye breathed a sigh of relief in his heart.
It seems that people in the other camp still regard this world as an ordinary game world, and do not realize that this is a completely constructed world. Every NPC is a person with a soul, and those who trespass are their players.
When it comes to body searches, the most correct approach should be to separate the nobles from the common people. First, respectfully invite the people to their residences. After that, someone with a high status will come forward to explain the interests to the lords themselves. Only after the lords agree can they send people with the same status as the knights to search the body.
In such a complex world, if all aspects are not considered, even if you have the power, it is impossible to make others act according to your own ideas.
Words like "decent" and "formalism" seem meaningless, but some nobles would rather sell their houses and land and rack up debts to maintain the dignity that matches their title. This was true in ancient times, and it is true now. No matter what era, never underestimate the human heart.
Duke Garcia's cargo team broke into commotion, and disrespectful words quickly spread to every corner of the team.
The civilians waiting to enter the city didn't care about these things, but the queen's birthday was approaching, and most of the nobles from other places were in front of the door to deliver gifts. They were very dissatisfied with waiting in line, but after word of this spread, they began to resist.
Xing Ye, the instigator of everything, quietly retreated into the team after inciting the knight captain. The news spread like a tide. Who knows where the source is?
Morse approached Xing Ye and said without giving up: "Lawrence, Duke Garcia has arrived in the imperial city first. After inspection, we will transport the goods to his mansion. How about I recommend you as an excellent knight to the Duke?"
Xing Ye did not object: "Okay."
Morse was rejected all the way, and when he saw him nodding, he almost jumped up with joy.
Xing Ye touched the mirror in his arms. Public opinion had already been stirred up. He was indeed going to meet Duke Garcia next, but not to become a knight, but to test the golden finger given to him by the system.
"What's going on?" A man who looked like the captain came over and stood beside Duke Garcia's cargo team casually, "Why is there such a big commotion?""Your Excellency, you are the captain of the royal guard?" the knight captain gave a humble salute, "We are the knights of Duke Garcia, and the goods on the car are the birthday gifts from His Highness the Duke to Her Majesty the Queen. Are you planning to let a team like ours block the city gate in front of a group of civilians, slaves, and remote nobles, and be searched by mere city gate guards? Do you have the consent of Duke Garcia for such a move?"
After hearing his words and the identity of Duke Garcia, the surrounding noble knights also gathered together, and everyone echoed in unison, asking the royal family to give the nobles the dignity they deserve.
The noisy scene made the guard a little panicked. He immediately drew his sword and shouted loudly: "This is the Queen's order. The Royal Guards are only loyal to Her Majesty the Queen. We will execute every order of the Queen. Your Majesty is considering the security of the entire country. Do you want to rebel?"
Xing Ye, who was hiding in the crowd and observing secretly, held his forehead. It was obvious that the captain of the guard was the second manipulator. The ending he chose was for the queen to capture Claire who hid the mirror and execute her.
